room_rent.note: Fixed ₹ per day limits; ICU at 1.5x normal room limit. Proportionate deduction applies if higher room taken.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in policy wording

sub_limits.display: Many sub-limits: cataract, maternity, cancer, cardiac, joint replacement, etc.
sub_limits.note: 23 disease/procedure categories sub-limited per policy year; e.g. cataract ₹25K-₹50K, cancer ₹1L-₹2L, CABG ₹1.5L-₹2L, joint replacement ₹1.5L-₹2.5L

initial_waiting.note: Except accidents; waived if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: No optional reduction mentioned; reducible via portability/migration credit

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (most); 36 months (joint replacement, osteoporosis, maternity, bariatric)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hysterectomy, LASIK etc.; 36-month list includes joint replacement, bariatric surgery

maternity.note: Normal delivery ₹35K-₹50K; C-section ₹30K-₹60K depending on SI; max 2 lifetime claims; pre/post natal excluded; portability/migration not applicable

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% added per claim-free year; reduced by 10% on claim; max 100% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Up to Sum Insured; disease sub-limits apply

post_hosp.note: Up to Sum Insured; disease sub-limits apply

day_care.note: Plus any other procedures agreed by insurer requiring <24hr hospitalisation due to technology advancement

ayush.display: Covered up to SI (disease sub-limits apply)
ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH hospitalisation covered; preventive/rejuvenation and OPD excluded

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense benefit mentioned

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; over and above disease sub-limits but subject to SI availability

modern_treatments.display: Sub-limited (disease sub-limit or 50% of SI, whichever lower)
modern_treatments.note: 12 listed procedures including robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy etc.

consumables.note: Consumables/Non-Medical Expenses Cover available as optional cover on additional premium; covers List I items in Annexure II

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment in India only (Section 7.1.7 & 6.2.14)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to enhanced SI from date of enhancement

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/quarterly/half-yearly; 15 days for monthly instalment; coverage not available during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable at inception only; not on renewals or porting

portability.note: IRDAI portability norms apply; waiting period credit for prior continuous coverage

notable_exclusions.display: Treatment outside India, external congenital anomaly, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell storage, OPD, dental (non-injury), durable medical equipment post-discharge

optional_riders.note: Only one optional cover mentioned in policy wording
